text.tspan: Ingress controller keeps crashing under load: find why, stabilise, protect
kubectl describe pod → Last State / Reason / Exit Code · kubectl logs <pod> --previous · kubectl get events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp
Readiness failing just removes a pod from rotation; liveness failing kills it and makes overload worse.
ingress-nginx was announced for retirement (Nov 2025, maintenance to Mar 2026): plan for Gateway API. Check current status.
